the Industrial Revolution: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the 1700s, when machines started replacing hand work in factories.
工業革命在十八世紀始於英國，當時工廠裡的機器開始取代手工。
industrial waste: The factory was fined for dumping industrial waste into the river, which killed thousands of fish.
這家工廠因將工業廢棄物倒入河中而被罰款，造成數千條魚死亡。
industrial relations: Good industrial relations depend on managers and workers talking openly about pay and working hours.
良好的勞資關係取決於管理者和員工公開討論薪資與工時。
industrial action: The bus drivers took industrial action and refused to work until the company agreed to raise their pay.
公車司機發起罷工抗爭，拒絕上班，直到公司同意加薪為止。
an industrial estate: Many factories and warehouses are located in an industrial estate on the edge of the city.
許多工廠和倉庫都位於城市邊緣的一處工業區內。
industrial-strength: We needed industrial-strength glue to fix the broken leg of the heavy wooden table.
我們需要工業級強度的膠水來修理那張沉重木桌斷掉的桌腳。
an inevitable consequence: Gaining weight is an inevitable consequence of eating fast food every day and never exercising.
每天吃速食又從不運動，體重增加是必然的結果。
It was inevitable that…: After their best player got hurt, it was inevitable that the team would lose the championship game.
最好的球員受傷之後，這支隊伍輸掉冠軍賽是不可避免的。
bow to the inevitable: When the shop lost money for five years in a row, the owner finally bowed to the inevitable and closed it.
當店連續五年虧損時，老闆終於向命運低頭，把店收了。
the inevitable question: At every family dinner during Chinese New Year, my aunt asks the inevitable question: "When are you getting married?"
每年過年的家族聚餐，阿姨都會問那個意料中的問題：「你什麼時候結婚？」
be inferior to: Many people believe that frozen vegetables are inferior to fresh ones, but they are often just as healthy.
許多人認為冷凍蔬菜比新鮮蔬菜差，但它們往往一樣健康。
inferior goods: The store was selling inferior goods that broke after only a few days, so many customers asked for refunds.
這家店賣的是劣質品，用沒幾天就壞了，所以許多顧客要求退款。
feel inferior: Comparing yourself to others on social media can make you feel inferior to people whose lives look perfect.
在社群媒體上和別人比較，可能會讓你在那些生活看似完美的人面前感到自卑。
an inferiority complex: Growing up with a brilliant older brother gave Tom an inferiority complex that lasted for many years.
在有個優秀哥哥的環境下長大，讓湯姆產生了持續多年的自卑感。
inferior in quality: The cheap shoes looked nice online, but they were inferior in quality and fell apart after a week.
那雙便宜的鞋子在網路上看起來不錯，但品質較差，一週後就壞了。
infinite patience: Teaching young children to read takes infinite patience, because they often forget what they learned yesterday.
教小孩子閱讀需要無限的耐心，因為他們常常忘記昨天學過的東西。
infinite wisdom: In their infinite wisdom, the managers decided to hold the company picnic during typhoon season.
管理階層憑著他們「無窮的智慧」，決定在颱風季舉辦公司野餐。
an infinite number of: In math, there are an infinite number of points on a line, so you could never count them all.
在數學中，一條線上有無數的點，所以你永遠也數不完。
infinite space: Looking up at the stars, I felt tiny compared with the infinite space of the universe.
仰望星空時，我覺得自己和宇宙無垠的太空相比非常渺小。
take infinite care: The museum workers took infinite care when moving the thousand-year-old vase, so it would not get even a tiny scratch.
博物館人員搬運那只千年花瓶時無比小心，確保它連一點小刮痕都不會有。
an influential figure: Confucius was an influential figure whose ideas about education still shape schools in Asia today.
孔子是一位有影響力的人物，他的教育思想至今仍影響著亞洲的學校。
a highly influential book: Silent Spring was a highly influential book that made millions of people care about protecting the environment.
《寂靜的春天》是一本影響深遠的書，讓數百萬人開始關心環境保護。
be influential in shaping: Parents are influential in shaping their children's eating habits, so they should set a good example at meals.
父母對形塑孩子的飲食習慣有影響力，所以吃飯時應該以身作則。
an informative talk: The doctor gave an informative talk about healthy sleep, and we all learned many useful tips.
醫生做了一場關於健康睡眠、內容豐富的演講，我們都學到了許多實用的訣竅。
highly informative: The museum guide was highly informative, giving us interesting facts about every painting in the gallery.
博物館導覽資訊非常豐富，為我們介紹了展廳裡每幅畫的有趣知識。
informative and entertaining: The science show is both informative and entertaining, so kids laugh a lot while learning about nature.
這個科學節目兼具知識與娛樂，所以孩子們在認識大自然的同時也笑聲不斷。
be inherent in: Some danger is inherent in extreme sports, because the risk is a natural part of the activity itself.
某些危險是極限運動固有的，因為風險本來就是這項活動的一部分。
an inherent risk: Investing in stocks always carries an inherent risk, since prices can go down as well as up.
投資股票總是帶有固有的風險，因為股價可能漲也可能跌。
inherent weaknesses: The engineer pointed out inherent weaknesses in the bridge's design that could not be fixed by simple repairs.
工程師指出這座橋設計上的內在弱點，那些不是簡單修補就能解決的。
the inherent dignity of: The law protects the inherent dignity of every person, no matter how rich or poor they are.
法律保障每個人固有的尊嚴，無論他們多富有或多貧窮。
